posts.title: A Panoramic of Lacko castle
posts.description: Lacko castle is a well-preserved medieval Baroque castle seen against a blue sky, surrounded by foliage and waterbody. Built in 1298, it is located on Kållandsö island on Lake Vänern, 25 kilometers north of Lidköping, Sweden. It has extensive scenic grounds situated on a rocky promontory on Lake Vanern. posts.title: Golden Birches of Abisko
posts.description: Fiery gold leafed birch trees are seen against the backdrop of placid Lake Torneträsk and surrounding mountains. The ground is covered with low-lying vegetation of mosses, lichens and shrubs in the fresh crisp Arctic days. A long low cloud is seen hanging over the lake as well. posts.title: Shyok river valley
posts.description: A view from above by the Turtuk village. The turquoise colored Shyok river (a tributary of River Indus) is seen flowing through desert and snow capped mountains of the Himalayas.
